hpi: Calcium chloride, insulin, hyperkalemia, potassium predisposition. Patients with hyperkalemic emergencies due to NSAID and ACE inhibitor use should be treated with calcium, insulin, and dextrose. These patients will exhibit signs of hyperkalemia. Cardiac status is very important in these patients. Dialysis can be attempted first, and if the patient continues to be refractory from initial treatment, then dialysis can be considered.
